data.headline: Elme sold its Bethesda community for $58.0 million

claims.text: On August 11, 2026, Bethesda Seller completed the sale of Elme Bethesda.

citation.quote: On August 11, 2026, Bethesda Seller completed the sale of Elme Bethesda to Tilden Bethesda Hill Apartment

claims.text: The sold community had 193 units and was located in Bethesda, Maryland.

citation.quote: for the sale of Elme Bethesda, a 193-unit community located in Bethesda, Maryland, and, following receipt of a certificate

claims.text: The purchase price was $58.0 million, subject to customary prorations and adjustments.

citation.quote: for a purchase price of $58.0 million, subject to customary prorations and adjustments.

claims.text: Elme identifies rent control, rent stabilization legislation and other regulatory restrictions as factors that may affect rent decisions, including its ability to increase rents.

citation.quote: rent control, rent stabilization legislation and other regulatory restrictions may impact the manner in which we make rent decisions, including restrictions on the use of algorithmic devices or systems, our ability to increase rents
